about: Client store corpus. The format and every rule id are in docs/client-store.md.

cases.why: Two clients, three keys and a revoked digest: the common shape.
No clients and no revoked digests: the first document a store holds.
1 is the lowest version a document can carry.
2^53-1 is the highest version a document can carry.
64 clients is the most a document holds.

One client at every upper limit: a 63-character name, the largest budget, a ceiling of exactly 1, 64 model patterns (one of 128 characters), 16 pins (one of 63 characters) and 2 keys with 64-character labels.
One client at the lower limits: a budget of 1, a ceiling just above 0, the pattern `*` and an empty label.
Real model names from several providers, a one-character pattern, and every punctuation character a pattern may hold, with and without the trailing `*`.
Names may be all digits, and leading zeros matter: `007`, `10` and `9` are three names.

The format does not know a deployment's operators or admin readers, so a client named `operator` is valid here. A store that reserves the name refuses it, and a reader that does drops the client after the envelope rules, outside the format.
Revoked digests with no clients.
A client may hold no keys.
Key ids need only be unique within their client.
`constructor` is a valid name, and the one every plain JavaScript object already holds: a store or reader that keeps clients in a plain object instead of a Map gets it wrong.
A label may hold `"` and `\`, which the document text escapes and the poll answer escapes again.
A document is a JSON object.
`null` is not an object, though JavaScript's `typeof` says it is.
A reader keeps its last good document when it meets a schema it does not read.
A newer schema reports as a schema fault, not as the unknown member it brings, because the schema is checked first.
A document without a schema has no schema a reader reads.
The schema is the integer 1, not the string.
A top-level member schema 1 does not define.
Every top-level member is required.
`revoked_digests` is required even when empty.
Version 0 means no document, so no document carries it.
Versions are not negative.
2^53 is past the largest version.
A version is an integer.
A version is a number, not a string.
The timestamp form always carries milliseconds.
The timestamp form is UTC with `Z`, not an offset.
A timestamp is a string.
A pattern matches the whole value, so a trailing line feed breaks it.
`clients` is an array.
Each client is an object.
A client is an object, not `null`.
65 clients is one more than a document holds.
A client without a name cannot be quarantined by name, so the document is refused.
A name is a string.
A name has at least one character.
Names are lowercase.
A leading `_` is reserved.
`_` alone is reserved.
A name starts with a letter or a digit.
64 characters is one more than a name holds.
A space is outside the name alphabet.
`.` is outside the name alphabet.
A name is ASCII.
Two clients cannot share a name.
A name is a string; JavaScript's `RegExp.test` would turn `["acme"]` into one.
A pattern matches the whole value, so a trailing line feed breaks it.
A client without `keys` leaves its digests unknown, so the document is refused.
`keys` is an array.
Each key is an object.
Every key has a digest.
A key is an object, not `null`.
`revoked_digests` is an array.
Digests are lowercase hex, so one value has one spelling.
A digest is 64 characters.
A digest is hex.
A digest is a string.
A `digest` member that is `null` is present but is not a digest.
A digest is a string, not an array holding one.
A pattern matches the whole value, so a trailing line feed breaks it.
Revoked digests follow the digest form too.
One digest in two clients would map one key to two names.
Two keys of one client cannot share a digest.
A key whose digest is revoked cannot stay in the document.
A revoked digest is listed once.
Breaks two rules on purpose: a client fault (a budget of 0) and an envelope fault (a repeated name). Any envelope fault refuses the whole document.
A per-client guard policy is not part of schema 1.
Every client member is required, even when empty.
A budget is at least 1; no budget is `null`.
A budget is not negative.
2^53 is past the largest budget.
A budget is an integer.
A budget is a number, not a string.
A ceiling is above 0; no ceiling is `null`.
A ceiling is at most 1.
A ceiling is not negative.
A ceiling is a number, not a string.
`models` is an array.
65 patterns is one more than a client holds.
A store client is denied by disabling its name, not by the empty pattern.
`*` only ends a pattern.
`*` only ends a pattern, so it cannot start a longer one.
`*` appears at most once.
A space is outside the pattern alphabet.
A pattern holding `,` could never match.
`"` is outside the pattern alphabet.
`\` is outside the pattern alphabet.
Control characters are outside the pattern alphabet.
A pattern is ASCII.
129 characters is one more than a pattern holds.
A pattern is a string.
A pattern is a string, not an array holding one.
DEL (0x7F) is outside the pattern alphabet.
`preferred_endpoints` is an array.
17 pins is one more than a client holds.
Endpoint names follow the name rule.
An endpoint name has at least one character.
64 characters is one more than a name holds.
An endpoint name is a string; JavaScript's `RegExp.test` would turn 7 into one.
An endpoint name is a string, not an array holding one.
Three keys is one more than a client holds. Every digest is still mapped to its name, so all three are refused.
A key member schema 1 does not define.
Every key member is required.
Key ids are lowercase.
A key id is `k` and 7 hex digits.
A key id is `k` and 7 hex digits.
A key id's digits are hex.
A key id is a string.
A pattern matches the whole value, so a trailing line feed breaks it.
Two keys of one client cannot share an id.
65 characters is one more than a label holds.
Control characters are outside the label alphabet.
A label is ASCII.
A label is a string; an empty label is `""`.
DEL (0x7F) is outside the label alphabet.
`created_at` is a full timestamp.
A timestamp is a string.
Each client fault quarantines only its own client.
